page.layout: Two engraved medallion portraits side by side at the top, each with its legend around the rim (left: LYCVRGVS and LACEDÆ.; right: DIRCEVS). Below them, one column of running text in two paragraphs, the first on Lycurgus and the second on Dircaeus, with no margin notes. A small woodcut ornament sits at the foot of the page, below the text. Running head at top, page number at top left.

main_text.p: LYCVRGVS apud Lacedæmonas leges fanxit, imperante Latinis Aremulo, circiter annum mundi 3090. ante Chriftum natum 872. alij referunt ad annū mundi 3181. ante Chriftum natum 781. Primùm omnium 28. feniores inftituit, qui Regibus affisterent, & populari principatui repugnarent, rurfúfque populi iuribus aduerfus tyrannidem faueret. Secundò agros æqualiter diuifit. nummum aureum & argenteum ex vfu fuftulit: ferreum folum vtendum imperauit: priuatum luxum inhibuit. Cætera qui cupit noffe, adeat Plutarchum in vita Lycurgi. Fuit oratione breuis: quas tradidit leges, finxit fe ex Apollinis Delphici oraculo tenere, ne reiicerentur, quòd feuerae effent: indotatas iubebat accipi vxores, vt prolis non argenti gratia nuberent viri: tum vt ne puellae pauperes, innuptae relinquerentur. non inuentione legum magis quàm exemplo clarior extitit: fiquidem nihil lege vlla in alios fanxit, cuius nõ ipse primus in se documenta daret. Iustinus multis in locis. Auguft.de Ciui.Dei.lib.2.cap.16.& lib.10.cap.13. Plutar.in vita Lycurgi. Xenophon,in Athenienfium politia.

DIRCEVS, Athenienfis Poëta, deformis quidem, attamen tubæ inuentor fuit. Lacedæmonij etenim cùm responsum accepissent ab Apolline, non alio quàm hoc duce superaturos se aduersarios Messanos, hunc ducem elegerunt, qui in Campano agro clangore tubarum Messanos ita exterruit, vt animo consternati, ac in fugâ versi, facilè victi sint. Vide Mag.Elucida.

page.notes: The two medallion portraits are engravings with legends around the rim; the legends are transcribed above as separate lines. The woodcut ornament at the foot is decorative and not text. No doubtful readings in the body text.
